chunks: He said: 'O Lord, I seek refuge in You from asking You for that of which I have no knowledge. And if You do not forgive me and have mercy on me, I shall be among those who perish.'
ai.seo_question: What was Noah's prayer when his people refused to believe?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often cited as the epitome of prophetic humility, illustrating that even the steadfast Noah (AS) relied on divine mercy rather than his own knowledge to secure salvation. It underscores the theological principle that human agency is insufficient without Allah's grace (Tawfiq), a concept central to Shia understanding of the interplay between free will and divine decree. The supplication serves as a model for believers to acknowledge their limitations and seek forgiveness before the final reckoning.
